main_text.p: Sed & eodem tempore populus fuam Democratiæ non abjecit imaginem. multoque rectius de eo dici potuerat, quod apud Thucydidem de Periclea Athe- nienfium tempeftate jactatur: ἐξηγεῖτο τε λόγῳ μὲν, ἔργῳ δὲ, ὁ τῶν πρώτων ἀνὴρ. Verbo quidem, ftatus popularis; re autem vera, pes nes vitum in civitate principem imperium erat. lib. 2. Hiftor. Vix enim prifcæ libertatis umbram, nomi- nibus & ritum fpeciebus delufi, rerum domini Ro- mani tenebant. Quia tamen à Dionis patrocinio exs clufos, ad Strabonis protectionem confugere audio, quantum fit in illo perfugii recludam. Principio hos- mini ne quidem Græci generis, nedum Itali aut Ros mani, inter Armenios & Cappadocas barbaro, & non femel vanitatis aut ofcitantiæ etiam in leviori- bus con- vincendo, quique interiora reip. Romanæ arcana nuntiant quam penetraverit, tantum vel fidei vel autoritatis non tribuo, ut contra rerum Romanarum conflictus teftis idoneus fit audiendus. Quod proximum, & no-
main_text.notes: Marginal and gloss text is not present on this scan; the page carries the Greek phrase in the body, transcribed as best read. Several words near the lower left are blurred by show-through and the binding and are uncertain; the Greek line and the phrase "Quia tamen" are doubtful. The left edge shows bleed-through from the facing page, which is not transcribed. Catchword and signature not visible.
